original_test_intent: Verify that every Type 17 Memory Array Handle uniquely references the correct Type 16 Physical Memory Array for that socket/device, matches the approved board topology and remains referentially stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 16/17 tables, build a unique Type 16 handle index, retain each Type 17 handle plus device/socket identity and population state, resolve every reference, compare the approved socket-to-array map, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the socket-to-array topology and reboot plan. Physical memory action is not required.
required_inputs: Expected Type 16 array for every Type 17 socket/device identity
Board socket, channel and array topology including unpopulated/disabled slots
Handle uniqueness and vendor-specific record policy
Stable Type 17 identity fields used across reboot
Validated parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and OS inventory only; do not change DIMMs, slots or firmware.
Resolve against the complete Type 16 table and require exactly one target of the correct type.
Retain empty Type 17 records and their handles; do not filter them by Size.
Surface orphan, duplicate, self-inconsistent and wrong-array references without silently repairing them.
Stop on ambiguous topology or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Build the Type 16 handle map, resolve all Type 17 references with socket identity/population context, compare topology and pre/post reboot relations.
Do not modify hardware, renumber handles to hide drift or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the physical socket-to-array map and empty/disabled record policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The displayed handle is relevant, but grep -A1 loses the Type 17 record/socket identity and cannot detect absent or duplicate Type 16 targets.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16/17 data; report each Type 17 handle/locator/population, referenced array handle and uniquely resolved Type 16 identity plus anomalies.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Memory Array Handle scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Index all Type 16 handles, resolve every Type 17 Memory Array Handle exactly once, compare each device/socket identity with the approved physical array map and repeat the graph after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Memory Array Handle and Type 16 structure/handle semantics, plus authoritative board topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns an isolated displayed value into complete referential-integrity and physical-topology validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects orphan/duplicate/wrong-type targets, wrong-array socket links, omitted empty slots and relationship drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Socket-to-array topology and record inclusion policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS handles may be renumbered across firmware revisions; semantic topology should be compared using stable record identities, while within-snapshot references must remain exact.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve handle renumbering across a deliberate firmware change, but all Type 17-to-Type 16 semantic relationships must remain correct; raw handle drift alone and semantic drift must be reported separately.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity and socket-to-array topology
Unique Type 16 handle index and every Type 17 reference/locator/population resolution
Orphan, duplicate, wrong-type and wrong-array analysis
Approved reboot/health evidence and raw plus semantic post-reboot graph comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The reference field and correctness/persistence criteria align; topology is an external project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Referential-integrity and topology checks are fully automatable after the approved map.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete target resolution, socket identity, topology mapping and graph anomalies.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safe topology checks while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates semantic versus raw handle persistence and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a hex handle from passing merely because it is formatted correctly when it has no unique Type 16 target or maps a socket to the wrong array.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a structured foreign-key relationship across finite SMBIOS tables, so referential and topology validation are deterministic software operations.
